namibia.name: Fish River Canyon
namibia.desc: Found in southern Namibia along the country's longest river — Africa's largest canyon and a premier hiking destination.

namibia.name: Damaraland & Kaokoland
namibia.desc: A destination in its own right — desert-adapted elephants, rhino tracking, and Himba culture between Etosha and the Skeleton Coast.

namibia.name: Namib-Naukluft Park
namibia.desc: One of the world's largest conservation areas — stretching from the central plateau to the iconic dunes of Sossusvlei.

namibia.name: Swakopmund & Walvis Bay
namibia.desc: Coastal resort towns where the Atlantic meets the desert — adventure sports, colonial architecture, and fresh seafood.

namibia.name: Kavango & Zambezi
namibia.desc: A lush riverine region with summer rainfall — crocodiles, hippos, and a tropical contrast to the arid south.

namibia.name: Kalahari Desert
namibia.desc: Eastern Namibia's red sand sea — home to San culture, solitude, and surprising wildlife around ephemeral rivers.

namibia.name: Etosha National Park
namibia.desc: One of the greatest and oldest game parks in Africa — Namibia's premier wildlife sanctuary centred on a vast salt pan.

namibia.name: Skeleton Coast Park
namibia.desc: Where the desert meets the Atlantic — shipwrecks, seal colonies, and desert-adapted lions along an eerie coastline.
